content:
anya: Quick sync — we're cutting SDK v0.9 and associated samplekit/quickstarts. Plan: changelog/docs/sample apps freeze in 24h from now (cutoff=1867086401). Who owns each piece? @sam @leah please confirm.

sam: I can own sample apps. Scope: update samplekit auth, migrate to streaming client API, fix CI so sample builds pass on mac/linux. ETA ~6h for PR. Will tag with #samplekit.

leah: I'll take quickstarts + docs migration notes. Need the final CLI flags (auth + streaming). @jun did the runtime rename land?

jun: runtime change merged to main - branch=opt-routing, no semver break. CLI flags are: `--stream` and `--auth-token <env>`. Example build cmd for samplekit: ```bash
make samplekit-build MODE=prod && ./scripts/package-sample --out dist/samplekit.tar.gz
```

sam: thanks. I'll update sample apps to call `client.stream()` and add a small adapter for older clients. PR will reference this thread: https://git.redwood/infra/samplekit/pulls/42 (WIP).

carol: release-bot: Heads up — I'll queue an RC run after PRs merge. Changelog cutoff window is 18-24h depending on blockers. If anything is breaking, call it out now.

leah: docs-bot: reminder — any new doc pages must include front-matter `release: 0.9` and `stability: experimental` if we're not confident. Also add migration note under /docs/migration/v0.9.md.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs pipeline requires front-matter `release: 0.9` and `sidebar: samplekit` for quickstarts to auto-publish. Also we only pick up pages on main; use PR title prefix `docs:`.

sam: Quick checklist (will update):
- [ ] samplekit auth fix (sam)
- [ ] add streaming example (sam)
- [ ] quickstart + migration note (leah)
- [ ] update changelog entry (carol)
- [ ] CI green for mac/linux (sam)

jun: One more note: prefix caching behavior changed (kv-cache TTL default 30s) — might affect sample app expectations. Add a note in quickstart: `set KV_CACHE_TTL=0` for deterministic demos.

leah: Good catch. I'll add a callout in the streaming quickstart and the migration doc.

sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/samplekit/pulls/42 — includes auth adapter + docs stub. CI failing on mac runner; investigating.

carol: If CI doesn't clear within 8h, we gate and move to next RC. Let me know asap if you need assistance with runners.

anya: Thanks all. Action items: sam (samplekit PR + fix runner), leah (docs + migration note), jun (confirm no further runtime knob changes), carol (changelog + RC). We'll reconvene in this thread when PRs land. :thumbsup:

sam: attaching a tiny streaming payload example in a gist (will paste link here once uploaded).

leah: I'll draft the migration note and ping here for review.

release-bot: Scheduled RC job created (id=rc-2026-03-17-01). Will trigger when tag `v0.9-rc` is present.

anya: Leaving this open for async check-ins. Resolve when all PRs merged and RC triggered.

sam: CI green on linux, mac flaky — working with infra to repro.

leah: docs PR ready for review: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/135 (includes quickstart and migration note).

anya: Great progress — marking as soft-blocker until changelog entry added.

sam: will add changelog note in samplekit PR and ping carol.

carol: got it, I'll draft changelog and watch for the PR link.

anya: thanks everyone.
